analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($589.51) vs SMA5 ($578.16)/SMA20 ($547.09)/SMA50 ($530.77): short- to mid-term trend above, indicating bullish dominance.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($549.75)/SMA200 ($456.17): mid- to long-term trend strength is robust.
· 52-week position (83.2%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.8→66.8): entering overbought territory, indicating strengthening bullish momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (6.3757→4.8903): sustained improvement, signaling continuation of bullish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper Band $606.07): approaching upper band, confirming potential for further upside.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($536.12): based on pivot and mid- to long-term moving averages, confirming strong support.
· Swing resistance ($618.84): based on recent high and Pivot R1, expecting further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low continuation): indicating strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.70): subdued volume, suggesting potential for short-term consolidation.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): buy entry conditions met, but short-term overbought pressure warrants consideration for caution.
